title: pdf-to-latex plan.json
description: Agent<->script contract for the pdf-to-latex formula. Seeded by check-prereqs; each helper step reads and extends it. Helpers are testable in isolation: feed a plan.json + fixtures, assert the extended plan.json / body.tex. Objects are open (additionalProperties: true) so a downstream step may extend without a schema bump.

schema_version.description: Schema contract version. Bump on a breaking shape change.

vars.description: The formula vars as resolved for this run, echoed so helpers are self-contained.

paper_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing the input PDF and all output artifacts.

tex_engine.description: TeX engine for the compile gate.

preamble_path.description: Absolute path to a custom preamble.tex. Empty => bundled preamble.tex.

extra_kinds.description: JSON array string of extra theorem-like kinds (e.g. '["Sublemma"]').

skip_kinds.description: JSON array string of kinds to exclude from inventory.

converter_venv.description: Path to a Python venv to activate before running the converter. Empty = use PATH as-is.

input_pdf.description: Absolute path to the discovered input PDF. Set by check-prereqs once the PDF is identified.

raw_output.description: Absolute path to the converter's raw output file (_raw.md or _raw.tex). Set by run-converter.

inventory_counts.description: Per-kind entry counts extracted from numbering.json. Set by build-inventory.

flags.description: Tier-2 flag-and-defer records. A helper that meets an ambiguity it cannot resolve appends a flag here; the agent resolves each flag and fills `resolution`.

id.description: Stable flag id, e.g. F1, F2.

severity.description: blocker => must be resolved before the compile gate can pass.

stage.description: Which step raised it: check-prereqs | build-inventory | run-converter | wrap-body | emit-preamble | compile-and-verify.

kind.description: Machine tag, e.g. multiple-pdfs | converter-missing | unwrapped-theorem | page-count-skew.

message.description: Human-readable description of what was deferred and why.

location.description: File or context the flag points at.

resolution.description: Filled by the agent (Tier 3) when resolved. null = unresolved.

log.description: Append-only step log built up as the formula progresses.
